text:
Here is the complete test suite in Gherkin (BDD DSL) notation:

```gherkin
Feature: Doorstop Requirements Management

  Scenario: Unique and Permanent Identifiers
    Given a new Doorstop project
    When I create a linkable section of text
    Then the section should have a unique and permanent identifier

  Scenario: Formatting within Linkable Text
    Given a new Doorstop project
    When I create a linkable section of text with formatting
    Then the section should display the formatting correctly

  Scenario: Storage of External Requirements Assets
    Given a new Doorstop project
    When I import an external requirements asset
    Then the asset should be stored in Doorstop

  Scenario: Importing Content from Other Requirements Management Tools
    Given a new Doorstop project
    When I import content from another requirements management tool
    Then the content should be imported correctly

  Scenario: Exporting Content to Common Text/Document Tools
    Given a new Doorstop project
    When I export content to a common text/document tool
    Then the content should be exported correctly

  Scenario: Viewing Requirements as a Document
    Given a new Doorstop project with requirements
    When I view the requirements as a document
    Then the document should display the requirements correctly

  Scenario: Viewing Document Items Interactively
    Given a new Doorstop project with requirements
    When I view the document items interactively
    Then the items should be displayed correctly

  Scenario: Baseline Versions of Requirements
    Given a new Doorstop project with requirements
    When I create a baseline version of a requirement
    Then the baseline version should be stored correctly

  Scenario Outline: Unique and Permanent Identifiers with Examples
    Given a new Doorstop project
    When I create a linkable section of text with identifier <identifier>
    Then the section should have a unique and permanent identifier

    Examples:
      | identifier |
      | 12345      |
      | abcdef     |
      | 98765      |

  Scenario Outline: Formatting within Linkable Text with Examples
    Given a new Doorstop project
    When I create a linkable section of text with formatting <formatting>
    Then the section should display the formatting correctly

    Examples:
      | formatting |
      | **bold**    |
      | *italic*    |
      | __underline__|

  Scenario Outline: Storage of External Requirements Assets with Examples
    Given a new Doorstop project
    When I import an external requirements asset <asset>
    Then the asset should be stored in Doorstop

    Examples:
      | asset      |
      | requirements.docx |
      | requirements.pdf  |
      | requirements.txt  |

  Scenario Outline: Importing Content from Other Requirements Management Tools with Examples
    Given a new Doorstop project
    When I import content from another requirements management tool <tool>
    Then the content should be imported correctly

    Examples:
      | tool        |
      | ReqMan      |
      | JIRA        |
      | Excel       |

  Scenario Outline: Exporting Content to Common Text/Document Tools with Examples
    Given a new Doorstop project
    When I export content to a common text/document tool <tool>
    Then the content should be exported correctly

    Examples:
      | tool        |
      | Word       |
      | PDF        |
      | Text        |

  Scenario Outline: Viewing Requirements as a Document with Examples
    Given a new Doorstop project with requirements
    When I view the requirements as a document <document>
    Then the document should display the requirements correctly

    Examples:
      | document |
      | requirements.docx |
      | requirements.pdf  |
      | requirements.txt  |

  Scenario Outline: Viewing Document Items Interactively with Examples
    Given a new Doorstop project with requirements
    When I view the document items interactively <items>
    Then the items should be displayed correctly

    Examples:
      | items      |
      | requirements.docx |
      | requirements.pdf  |
      | requirements.txt  |

  Scenario Outline: Baseline Versions of Requirements with Examples
    Given a new Doorstop project with requirements
    When I create a baseline version of a requirement <requirement>
    Then the baseline version should be stored correctly

    Examples:
      | requirement |
      | requirement1 |
      | requirement2 |
      | requirement3 |
```

And here is the JSON list of test cases:

  {"id": "TC-002", "title": "Formatting within Linkable Text", "req_ids": ["REQ004"], "kind": "positive", "preconditions": ["new Doorstop project"], "inputs": {"formatting": "**bold**"}, "steps": ["create a linkable section of text with formatting", "verify formatting"], "expected": ["correct formatting"]},
  {"id": "TC-003", "title": "Storage of External Requirements Assets", "req_ids": ["REQ001"], "kind": "positive", "preconditions": ["new Doorstop project"], "inputs": {"asset": "requirements.docx"}, "steps": ["import external requirements asset", "verify asset stored"], "expected": ["asset stored in Doorstop"]},
  {"id": "TC-004", "title": "Importing Content from Other Requirements Management Tools", "req_ids": ["REQ016"], "kind": "positive", "preconditions": ["new Doorstop project"], "inputs": {"tool": "ReqMan"}, "steps": ["import content from another requirements management tool", "verify content imported"], "expected": ["content imported correctly"]},
  {"id": "TC-005", "title": "Exporting Content to Common Text/Document Tools", "req_ids": ["REQ017"], "kind": "positive", "preconditions": ["new Doorstop project"], "inputs": {"tool": "Word"}, "steps": ["export content to common text/document tool", "verify content exported"], "expected": ["content exported correctly"]},

  {"id": "TC-012", "title": "Importing Content from Other Requirements Management Tools with Examples", "req_ids": ["REQ016"], "kind": "positive", "preconditions": ["new Doorstop project"], "inputs": {"tool": "ReqMan"}, "steps": ["import content from another requirements management tool", "verify content imported"], "expected": ["content imported correctly"]},

  {"id": "TC-016", "title": "Baseline Versions of Requirements with Examples", "req_ids": ["REQ009"], "kind": "positive", "preconditions": ["new Doorstop project with requirements"], "inputs": {"requirement": "requirement1"}, "steps": ["create baseline version of a requirement", "verify baseline version stored"], "expected": ["baseline version stored correctly"]}
